summary: The tape was quiet for the book and no held thesis broke on news. WMT was sold today on its XLP clause, not on news. The new items on holdings were minor. MSCI got a target raise (Autonomous, $805 to $808). DPZ's Chief Restaurant Officer sold about $993K of stock, which is sentiment, not an 8-K event. INCY got Mizuho's $148 target (11-20), and partner Dermavon started a China Phase III of povorcitinib (11-21), a partner trial, not a pivotal readout. SAM's Hodges CEO handover took effect today with no guidance item. Koch's continuing role is still unstated because the 11-19 8-K 5.02 is unread. KR: bankers have contacted retailers, now named as Walmart, Target and Kroger, about buying Grubhub (11-22 and 11-23). There is no bid and no 8-K. The 11-19 baby-food report has had no recall or agency follow-up. KR fell 1.9% on a day SPY rose about 4.7% (565.41 vs 539.98), the only holding down. That coincides with the Grubhub reports, but my input can't tie the move to them (inference only). IDXX, VRSN, CARG and TLT had no item. My input also has no macro, rates or chip headline that explains SPY's rebound, just as it had none for the 11-19 drop. Per L2, I checked every holding's own estimate and 7-day filings. None prints inside 5 sessions, and there is no 4.01, 4.02 or new 5.02 beyond SAM's of 11-19. Next dates: KR 12-03 (company-confirmed), MSCI 2027-01-27, IDXX 02-01, VRSN 02-04, INCY 02-09, CARG 02-18, DPZ 02-22 and SAM 02-23 (file estimates). TLT is an ETF with no earnings.
upcoming: 11-24: ADSK and BBY both have file-estimated prints (last year's date + 364 days). Deutsche Bank's 'ahead of F3Q earnings' preview supports an imminent ADSK print without dating it. Neither is held. GLD's 11-24 'earnings' entry is a data artifact. BLBD's company date of 12-02 enters the 5-day window on 11-24, and the 11-23 file estimate passed as expected, so that earlier flag is closed. UNFI's 12-01 estimate is now inside the window, and its 11-17 8-K 7.01 is still unexplained (not held). 11-25: KR's confirmed 12-03 call enters the 5-day window. It is 7 trading days out (the market is closed 11-26), and it is the first held-name print in the window since WMT. If a Grubhub bid surfaces before then, it becomes a capital-allocation question for the call. SAM's 11-19 8-K 5.02 ages out of the 7-day window around 11-27. 12-09: the FOMC (inside TLT's 20-session test), plus ADBE's estimated print. Threads: Grubhub (KR, and WMT now sold) is new and open. AYI's 11-20 8-K 1.01/2.03 is resolved by the 11-22 headline on a new term loan of up to $400M (not held). LNG's 11-17 8-K 1.01/2.03 is still unexplained, but FERC's 11-20 approval of the Sabine Pass expansion fits my financing inference (not held). CVS's CMS rule thread had no new item today. BTC and ETH have had no item for a fifth session, and there is no ETF or rates headline. The SMG Swiss Marketplace item is mis-tagged again.
